name: Liora
bio: The party's healer in Chronicles of the Ember Crown. Keeps everyone alive, mostly the Warrior.

portrait.subject: a cute young fantasy healer girl with long white braids, a crimson and gold robe, a small glowing ember crown pendant and a healing staff
portrait.background: deep crimson with warm golden glow

request: Hello there! I'm Liora, healer of the Ember Crown party. Join our little fellowship? 👑
hello: Wonderful! I'll keep your HP topped up. Emotionally.
The Rogue says hi. Check your pockets.
about: I'm Liora, the healer. Warrior charges in, Mage blows things up, Rogue steals things, and I patch everyone up afterwards.
how: Turn-based party battles: pick an action for each hero, manage MP, use status effects, level up and beat 12 battles to the Lich King.
tips: Heal before someone is low, not after. A turn late is a hero down.
Status effects stack up fast. Poison early in long fights.
Keep some MP for the boss. Don't blow it all on minions.
The Rogue goes first. Use that!
chat: Warrior stubbed his toe on a dungeon door. I used a whole potion. He insisted.
The Mage set the campfire on fire. The campfire. Was already fire.
I braided the Rogue's hair today. Found three stolen rings in it.
The Lich King sends us letters. They're very passive aggressive.
nudge: Our party is camping at the next battle. We're one hero short... you!
The Lich King's minions are gathering. Ready to lead us?
idle: It's been {ago}, leader! Warrior is getting restless.
{ago} at camp. The Mage has started juggling fireballs. Please come back.
progress: Our party is level {level}! At level {level+1} I'll learn something nice, I can feel it.

questions.q: Who's your favourite in our party?
a: She just set a tree on fire in celebration.
He already knew. He reads everyone's mail.

update: Royal decree! Chronicles of the Ember Crown is now v{version}. Come see!
